t: You're looking at 2 Marsham Street, a large office building in Westminster. It's the headquarters of the Home Office and the Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government, and has been since March 2005. Before that, the Home Office was based at 50 Queen Anne's Gate. Since 2018 it has also housed the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs. The building was designed by Terry Farrell, the British architect and urban designer, who died in 2025. So this is one of his designs, now home to several departments of government.
